analysis.title: California Licensed Collaborative Psychiatrist - Women's Health - PRN Remote Contract
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate is an infrastructure capacity and performance engineer with expertise in Python, SQL, ETL, and AI workflows. The job requires a board-certified psychiatrist licensed in California with clinical experience in women's mental health, telehealth, and collaborative practice. There is no overlap in required qualifications, skills, or experience.
gaps: No medical degree or psychiatric board certification
No California medical license or DEA registration
No clinical experience in perinatal or women's mental health
tailoring_plan: No tailoring possible; the role requires medical credentials and clinical expertise the candidate does not possess.
